images.title: Three ideas behind our numerals
images.purpose: Sums up the chapter in three ideas: a base, place value, and zero.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three cards in a row from left to right with an arrow between each pair.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 3 rounded cards with thin dark outlines. Card 1, teal (#0072B2) heading base, with 1, 10, 100 beneath. Card 2, amber (#E69F00) heading place value, with three small boxes holding 3, 7, 5. Card 3, green (#009E73) heading zero, with 4072 beneath, the 0 in green. Exactly 2 dark arrows, card 1 to card 2 and card 2 to card 3. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A base, place value and zero together make our numerals work.

image_decisions.why: The recap needs one clean visual summary of the chapter's big ideas.
